main.title: New roots
main.objective: Plant three seeds and leave the house by the garden door.
main.beat: The first rows make the inherited place yours.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: First harvest
main.objective: Harvest five crops and bring a basket to Mira’s counter.
main.beat: Mira recognises an old seed variety and the farm’s name.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: Meet the valley
main.objective: Meet six residents at work or along their daily routes.
main.beat: The player learns the town through people and useful places.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: Market day
main.objective: Earn 1,000 gold through the physical shipping bin.
main.beat: Cleo puts the homestead’s produce on the kitchen menu.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: The old bridge
main.objective: Deliver twenty timber and fifteen stone to the bridge work site.
main.beat: Repair opens a shorter route rather than a cosmetic quest flag.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: Community garden
main.objective: Craft three items and deliver six copper to the conservatory repair.
main.beat: A functioning shared garden reveals a letter with a harbour stamp.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: The lantern promise
main.objective: Supply the first village feast and meet the courier at Letter Court.
main.beat: The old delivery ledger points beyond Dewhaven.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: Letters across water
main.objective: Visit Aster Quay and examine Sera’s delivery ledger.
main.beat: Winter food deliveries once connected all four towns.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: Safe harbour
main.objective: Repair the landing winch with four copper and ten timber.
main.beat: A safe cliff landing becomes a visible route upgrade.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: Under the cliffs
main.objective: Walk the Saltwind trail and inspect the vault’s water diagram.
main.beat: The dungeon belongs to the coastal landscape and the delivery story.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: The tide remembers
main.objective: Complete the Tide Vault and return its chart to the boatworks.
main.beat: The chart reveals the orchard delivery route.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: The orchard road
main.objective: Follow Cedar Downs to Sunridge and visit the orchard kitchen.
main.beat: The player finds the family that used to prepare the autumn cargo.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: A long table
main.objective: Bring two preserves and four corn for the orchard table.
main.beat: Neighbours start using the shared table again.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: The quarry gate
main.objective: Clear and repair the glassworks approach using six timber and ten stone.
main.beat: The old industrial route becomes a real place to explore.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: Warm glass
main.objective: Recover the protected lens from the Ember Gallery.
main.beat: The lens was made for weather instruments and safer winter travel.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: Reading the weather
main.objective: Fit the lens to a bench instrument and compare its markings with the chart.
main.beat: Observation and engineering explain the observatory’s purpose.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: The unwritten atlas
main.objective: Bring the chart and lens to the Briar Archive.
main.beat: The atlas’s missing section is the upper mountain road.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: The upper road
main.objective: Repair the sheltered stair with eight timber and two iron.
main.beat: Wayfinding, rest landings and an escape route precede the climb.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: The sky road
main.objective: Complete the Observatory and recover the brass compass.
main.beat: The three instruments form a practical map of the valley.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: A safe passage
main.objective: Trace three marked route checks with Jun in one visit.
main.beat: The route is tested without waiting for a real winter season.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: Rooms for everyone
main.objective: Participate in the harbour, orchard and archive gatherings.
main.beat: Each town contributes a different kind of welcome.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: Four open doors
main.objective: Reopen one shared public room in each town with local deliveries.
main.beat: Restoration changes furnished interiors and resident routines.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: The first convoy
main.objective: Prepare three labelled deliveries, ship them and meet the convoy next morning.
main.beat: Goods move along routes the player repaired.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.

main.title: Farther lights
main.objective: Return the finished atlas to the village table and complete the homecoming.
main.beat: The ending opens everyday life, partner stories and repeatable town events.
main.turnIn: Physical giver, work site or letter desk; no journal reward claim.
